title: Fire Burns the Yin-Yang Sect
summary: Ye Fan realises that Nannan's seven-coloured stone saves her life whenever she is gravely ill, and makes her keep it; Hei Huang has been talking about taking her as a disciple and raising her to be a Great Emperor. Ye Fan plans to return the rescued children to their holy lands and expose the Yin-Yang Sect for stealing 'immortal seeds'. The sect strikes first with a Dragon Transformation level 8 elder, an artifact controller with a forbidden artifact, the Holy Maiden and a tracking Divine Lightning talisman. Ye Fan lures them to the Star-Killing Formation that Hei Huang and Pang Bo have set up outside Yan's great city, and burns the Dragon Transformation cultivators with the Fire Domain's colourless karmic fire, pushing to the legendary seventh layer with the Bodhi Seed. Pang Bo offers to stay behind so the others can escape. The Holy Maiden's Seven-Coloured Star Sand blocks the fire, but Ye Fan's Divine Beating Whip strikes her mind, and he destroys a trace of the Yin-Yang Sect Master's consciousness (Immortal Platform 2nd level), who vows the whole sect will hunt him. Ye Fan then decides to go to the Holy Cliff to look for the third of the Nine Secrets.
